summary: AI job-search workspace that builds tailored resumes and cover letters, tracks applications and matches your profile to roles.

pricing.details: Free, always free, no hidden costs — unlimited base resumes, free PDF export, 2 job-tailored resumes, 2 application packets, all resume templates, basic resume job matching and scoring, track up to 100 jobs, basic job insights, Chrome Job Clipper, map view, unlimited contact management and application autofills, up to 100 document uploads, ad-free. Pro 36 €/month, or 27 €/month billed 81 € every 3 months, or 24 €/month billed 145 € every 6 months — everything in Free plus unlimited job-tailored resumes and application packets, unlimited AI resume generations, AI-powered job-tailored resumes, unlimited AI cover letters, unlimited AI resume review and tailoring, advanced job matching and scoring, unlimited job tracking and advanced job insights, unlimited document uploads.
pricing.label: Freemium

Resume scoring and job matching, basic on Free, advanced on Pro
